# MCP tools

Every tool `akou mcp` lists, with its parameters and the annotations a harness reads to decide which tools it may run without asking. The server answers from the local API, so each tool does what the matching command or route does. `akou_ask` is listed only while akou's provider can answer, and never to a client that is itself that provider's harness. The page is generated from the server's tool list, and CI fails when it differs.

## akou_add_note

**Add a note**

Add a line to the live call's notepad, marked as written by you.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | yes |  |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "text"
  ],
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_ask

**Ask akou's provider**

Answer with akou's own configured provider. Prefer akou_context and answer yourself: akou_ask spawns another agent run on the user's subscription.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | `string` | yes |  |
| `call` | `string` | no | Which call: "live" (the one recording now), "last", or a call id. Use the live call unless the user names another one. |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "question": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "call": {
      "default": "live",
      "description": "Which call: \"live\" (the one recording now), \"last\", or a call id. Use the live call unless the user names another one.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "question"
  ],
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_context

**Context for a question**

The main tool for answering any question about a call: pass the user's question verbatim and answer from the pack it returns (a few thousand tokens, never the whole transcript). Also returns, as typed fields, the cursor for akou_read, the call state and memoStale. Cite wall-clock times as [HH:MM Name]; never present an offset as a time of day; never quote a line marked DRAFT as fact; if the call has ENDED, say so and when. If the answer is not in the pack, say so and name the time range to fetch.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: true`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | `string` | yes |  |
| `call` | `string` | no | Which call: "live" (the one recording now), "last", or a call id. Use the live call unless the user names another one. |
| `budget` | `integer` | no |  |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "question": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "call": {
      "default": "live",
      "description": "Which call: \"live\" (the one recording now), \"last\", or a call id. Use the live call unless the user names another one.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "budget": {
      "default": 6000,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 500,
      "maximum": 7000
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "question"
  ],
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_enhanced_put

**Save enhanced notes**

Save the enhanced notes you wrote for the latest call. Every bullet must end with the segment ids it rests on, like [#l000031]; a bullet without a real citation is dropped. Place the user's own notes by id (`- {n0004}`); they are kept word for word.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `markdown` | `string` | yes |  |
| `coversSeq` | `integer` | yes |  |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "markdown": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "coversSeq": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    }
  },
  "required": [

}
```

## akou_finalize

**Run the final pass**

Start the accurate final pass on an ended call (default the latest). It runs on its own; akou_get_call with layer `final` reads it once done. `force` runs it again on a call that has one; `model` picks qwen or parakeet for this run only.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call` | `string` | no |  |
| `force` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `model` | `"qwen" or "parakeet"` | no |  |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "call": {
      "default": "last",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "force": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "qwen",
        "parakeet"
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_get_call

**Read a named call**

A call the user named: its transcript from the start, one page at a time, each line with its segment id. When `nextCursor` is not null, call again with it as `cursor` for the next page, and the same `layer`. To answer a question, akou_context with `call` is cheaper than reading every page. Cite wall-clock times as [HH:MM Name]; never present an offset as a time of day; never quote a line marked DRAFT as fact; if the call has ENDED, say so and when.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: true`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call` | `string` | yes |  |
| `layer` | `"best" or "live" or "final"` | no |  |
| `cursor` | `string` | no | The nextCursor of the previous page; leave it out for the first page. |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "call": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "layer": {
      "default": "best",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "best",
        "live",
        "final"
      ]
    },
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The nextCursor of the previous page; leave it out for the first page.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "call"
  ],
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

| `id` | `string` | yes |  |

```json
  "properties": {
    "id": {

      "default": 50,

}
```

## akou_read

**Read new lines**

New committed lines since a cursor (the `cursor` field of akou_context or an earlier akou_read), plus the line still being spoken and the next cursor. Use it to follow a call instead of re-reading. Cite wall-clock times as [HH:MM Name]; never present an offset as a time of day; never quote a line marked DRAFT as fact; if the call has ENDED, say so and when.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: true`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call` | `string` | no | Which call: "live" (the one recording now), "last", or a call id. Use the live call unless the user names another one. |
| `since` | `integer` | no |  |
| `lastSeconds` | `integer` | no |  |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "call": {
      "default": "live",
      "description": "Which call: \"live\" (the one recording now), \"last\", or a call id. Use the live call unless the user names another one.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "since": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "lastSeconds": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 86400
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_start

**Start recording**

Start recording a call now. Make this the first call when the user wants a call recorded: no status check first. Returns once audio is being written. `vocab` takes call-scoped words known before the call (attendee names, title terms). If a call is already recording, starts nothing and returns that call with `attached: true`: follow it with akou_context and akou_read like one you started.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | `string` | no |  |
| `title` | `string` | no |  |
| `template` | `string` | no |  |
| `call` | `string` | no | What to capture as the call side: "system", "app:ID" or "none" |
| `mic` | `string` | no | The microphone: an input id from akou_devices |
| `vocab` | `string[]` | no |  |
| `engines` | `string[]` | no | The final pass's models for this call, in order, their words combined: "qwen", "parakeet" or model ids. Omit for the setting |
| `withoutModels` | `boolean` | no | Record audio now and transcribe it later, when the speech models are not downloaded yet. |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "template": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "call": {
      "description": "What to capture as the call side: \"system\", \"app:ID\" or \"none\"",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "mic": {
      "description": "The microphone: an input id from akou_devices",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "vocab": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "engines": {
      "description": "The final pass's models for this call, in order, their words combined: \"qwen\", \"parakeet\" or model ids. Omit for the setting",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "withoutModels": {
      "description": "Record audio now and transcribe it later, when the speech models are not downloaded yet.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_transcribe

**Transcribe a file on a server**

Transcribe an audio or video file on this machine as a job on the akou server (`AKOU_URL`, server mode): uploads the file once and waits up to `wait` seconds. A job that ends in time comes back done with its transcript in `result`; one still queued or running comes back with its `id` for akou_job_get. A path that is missing or not an audio or video file is refused and nothing is sent.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | yes | The file's path on this machine. |
| `preset` | `"lite" or "fast" or "best" or "fusion" or "auto"` | no | How much accuracy matters; auto lets the server choose. |
| `language` | `string` | no | A BCP-47 tag such as en or es, or auto. |
| `diarize` | `boolean` | no | Label the speakers. |
| `wait` | `integer` | no | Seconds to wait for the job to end, up to 50: a short voice note comes back done in the same call. |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The file's path on this machine."
    },
    "preset": {
      "description": "How much accuracy matters; auto lets the server choose.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "lite",
        "fast",
        "best",
        "fusion",
        "auto"
      ]
    },
    "language": {
      "description": "A BCP-47 tag such as en or es, or auto.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "diarize": {
      "description": "Label the speakers.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "wait": {
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Seconds to wait for the job to end, up to 50: a short voice note comes back done in the same call.",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 50
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

## akou_vocab_add

**Add a word**

Pass on a word the user stated ("it's Vercel, not versal"), with how it was heard. Scope "call" (the default) works like the user fixing a line: every line of the live call with that heard form reads corrected at once. A name, product or jargon word is also learned into the call's and the workspace's vocabulary with no review; a rewording of common words stays in this call only and goes into the call's Notes as "Fixed: heard -&gt; term" (so does any word while the live engine takes no word list). `decode: false` only corrects the reading of this call. "workspace" or "global" only writes the vocabulary file. Never add a word you inferred; propose it with akou_vocab_propose.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `term` | `string` | yes |  |
| `heard` | `string[]` | no |  |
| `scope` | `"call" or "workspace" or "global"` | no |  |
| `workspace` | `string` | no |  |
| `decode` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `note` | `string` | no |  |

<details markdown>
<summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "term": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "heard": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "scope": {
      "default": "call",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "call",
        "workspace",
        "global"
      ]
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "decode": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "term"
  ],
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
}
```

</details>

**List the vocabulary**
